task: Increase expected Material/PBR and Texture/Microdetail fidelity on benchmark-visible park and street furniture by replacing scalar-only surfaces with physical-scale deterministic microtextures while preserving manufactured geometry, cause-based weathering separation and render-evidence discipline.

commits.message: Add physical-scale park furniture microdetail pass
Add machine-readable park furniture microdetail contract
Gate benchmark saves on park furniture microdetail
Record park furniture microdetail readiness without visual credit

benchTimber.microstructure: lengthwise grain and restrained fine checks

uv.general: referenced manufactured furniture meshes are rewritten to dominant-face planar UV0 in physical metres
uv.physicalChute: authored path UV retained; U physical scale derives from 0.92 m width and V already tracks approximately 4.2 m run
uv.physicalDiffuser: lathed UV retained; scale derives from 0.43 m maximum diameter circumference and 0.255 m profile height

implementation.causeSeparation: manufacturing microtextures contain no sun direction, camera highlight, runoff streak, random macro dirt, ground-splash height or broad rust. Those remain owned by physical lighting and cause-based weathering.
implementation.metallicWorkflowCorrection: The final microdetail pass overrides early scalar bootstrap values for bare stainless/exposed steel to metallic=1.0; dielectric paint/timber/concrete/backing/diffuser remain <=0.05.
implementation.saveGate: When the detailed-ground benchmark scene is saved, the furniture chain now executes contract validation -> manufacture rebuild -> physical chute/diffuser refinement -> four-level LOD rebind -> 4K microdetail generation/application -> structural/profile/LOD/material/UV QA.

lookdev.mode: precise generation brief recorded because the current GitHub connector execution path cannot ingest a generated binary illustration into the repository

verification.branchDiffAtSubstantiveHead: 3 commits ahead, 0 behind startHead; three changed files, all under UnityProject

implementationReadiness.reasonNotIncreased: The remaining seven readiness points are Unity compile/runtime verification. Source coverage improved, but no real Unity runner evidence exists, so raising the readiness score would blur the distinction between implemented intent and executed proof.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.reason: material-specific roughness and strict bare-metal-vs-dielectric classification replace scalar-only surfaces; stainless response is left to real environment reflection rather than baked highlights
physical-scale 1024px microstructure plus metre-aware UV handling targets the close-up plastic/flatness tell on slide, bench, concrete, paint and diffuser
microtextures are forbidden from replacing 2 mm chute thickness, slat gaps, fasteners, frame rails or globe silhouette, preserving the manufactured geometry contract
stainless roughness/normal detail modulates the existing sky/probe reflection instead of painting specular cues
mipmaps, trilinear filtering and anisotropy 12 are enforced, but shimmer/LOD behavior cannot be credited without motion/render evidence

criticalFailProtection: dielectric materials fail QA if metallic exceeds 0.05
bare metal final materials fail QA if scalar metallic falls below 0.95
normal map importer and linear metallic/smoothness mask are mandatory
manufacture microtextures explicitly forbid baked highlights and generic random macro dirt
Visual Fidelity remains unscored without actual Unity renders
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and native 3840x2160 evidence. When it appears, stop new speculative detail and inspect 100% crops for stainless scratch contrast/false anisotropy, wood grain repetition/orientation, concrete pinhole scale, diffuser plasticity, mip shimmer and LOD pop; fix observed render defects first.
stopDatePolicy: Continue source-safe development only through 2026-09-18. On or after 2026-09-19, do not create new development commits unless new instructions explicitly extend the work; summarize state instead.
